title: Classmates
subtitle: 同班同學，究竟是哪一類同學？
description: 同班同學，究竟是哪一類同學？

words.meaning: 其他學生；一起讀書的同學
words.note: 同樣是學生的人。範圍可以比同班同學更廣，不一定在同一班。
words.example: She often studies with her fellow students after lectures.
words.exampleZh: 她經常在課堂後和其他同學一起溫習。

exercises.original: She often studies with her classmates after lectures, including students from other tutorial groups.
exercises.zh: 她經常在課堂後和其他同學一起溫習，包括來自其他導修小組的學生。
exercises.upgrade: fellow students · 其他學生；一起讀書的同學

options.explanation: colleagues = 同事。通常一起工作，不是一起讀書。這裡談的是學生。
fellow students = 其他同樣是學生的人。句子說包括其他導修小組的學生，所以範圍比同班更廣，很適合。
neighbours = 鄰居。住得近不表示一起上課。
teachers = 老師。老師與學生的角色不同。
roommates = 室友。一起住不代表一起讀書。
class = 班級或課堂，不是指一群同學中的個別學生。

exercises.original: He exchanged notes with classmates from several different classes in the same department.
exercises.zh: 他和同一學系內不同班別的其他學生交換筆記。
exercises.upgrade: fellow students · 其他學生；一起讀書的同學

options.explanation: fellow students = 同樣是學生的人。這些人來自不同班，所以比 classmates 更準確。
teachers = 老師。句子說的是同一學系內的學生。
neighbours = 鄰居。地理上的鄰近與學系無關。
roommates = 室友。沒有共同居住的意思。
colleagues = 同事。通常用於工作關係。
class = 班級，不是學生本人。

words.note: 年齡、身分、能力或階段相近的人。學生語境中常指與自己處於相近學習階段的同學。
words.example: He feels more confident speaking English with his peers.
words.exampleZh: 他和同輩同學說英語時更有自信。

exercises.original: He feels more confident speaking English with classmates of a similar age and level.
exercises.zh: 他和年齡及程度相近的同輩同學說英語時更有自信。
exercises.upgrade: peers · 同輩；同儕

options.explanation: teachers = 老師。不是同輩學生。
peers = 年齡、身分或程度相近的人。句子特別提到 similar age and level，所以最適合。
roommates = 室友。一起住不表示年齡或學習階段相近。
colleagues = 同事。通常是工作上的同輩。

exercises.original: Teenagers are often strongly influenced by their classmates of the same age.
exercises.zh: 青少年常常很受同齡同儕影響。
exercises.upgrade: peers · 同輩；同儕

options.explanation: peers = 同齡或同一社會階段的人。青少年受到同齡人的影響，peer 是自然用法。
neighbours = 鄰居。住得近不代表同齡。
roommates = 室友。不是句子的重點。
colleagues = 同事，通常用於工作。

words.note: 在同一所學校讀書的人，不一定在同一班。
words.example: She met several old schoolmates at the school reunion.
words.exampleZh: 她在校友聚會上遇到幾名昔日同校同學。

exercises.original: She met several old classmates from the same secondary school at the reunion, although they had been in different classes.
exercises.zh: 她在聚會上遇到幾名昔日同校同學，雖然當年大家在不同班。
exercises.upgrade: schoolmates · 同校同學

options.explanation: roommates = 室友。沒有一起住的意思。
schoolmates = 在同一所學校讀書的人。句子明說大家不同班但同校，所以最準確。
neighbours = 鄰居。不是學校關係。
project teammates = 同一專題組員。句子沒有專題背景。
class = 班級，不是同校學生。

exercises.original: Although they were never in the same class, the two classmates attended the same school for six years.
exercises.zh: 雖然他們從未同班，但兩人在同一所學校讀了六年。
exercises.upgrade: schoolmates · 同校同學

options.explanation: schoolmates = 同校學生。即使從未同班，只要在同一所學校讀書便可以使用。
study partners = 一起溫習的人。句子沒有說他們一起讀書。
neighbours = 鄰居。不是學校關係。
classmates = 同班同學。句子明說 never in the same class，所以不準確。

words.note: 修讀同一課程的人。未必每一堂課都在同一班，但屬於同一門課程。
words.example: My coursemates and I are preparing for the final presentation.
words.exampleZh: 我和同課程的同學正在準備期末簡報。

exercises.original: My classmates and I are all taking the same one-year photography course.
exercises.zh: 我和同課程的同學都在修讀同一個一年制攝影課程。
exercises.upgrade: coursemates · 同課程同學

options.explanation: coursemates = 修讀同一課程的人。句子明確說大家都在同一攝影課程。
class = 班級或課堂，不是人。

exercises.original: She created a group chat for classmates who were taking the same evening accounting course.
exercises.zh: 她為修讀同一夜間會計課程的同學建立了一個群組。
exercises.upgrade: coursemates · 同課程同學

options.explanation: schoolmates = 同校學生。範圍可能太廣。
coursemates = 同一課程的學生。句子特別指出 same evening accounting course。

words.meaning: 同屆成員；同一學習群組的同學
words.note: 同一時間開始某個課程、培訓或學習計劃的人。
words.example: The cohort members started the nursing program in the same year.
words.exampleZh: 這批同屆學生在同一年開始修讀護理課程。

exercises.original: The classmates all started the nursing program in the same year and will graduate together.
exercises.zh: 這批同學在同一年開始護理課程，並會一起畢業。
exercises.upgrade: cohort members · 同屆成員；同一學習群組的同學

options.explanation: cohort members = 同一時間開始同一課程的一批人。句子強調同一年入學及一起畢業。

exercises.original: She still keeps in touch with classmates who entered the teacher-training program with her in 2022.
exercises.zh: 她仍和2022年跟她一起入讀教師培訓課程的同屆同學保持聯絡。
exercises.upgrade: cohort members · 同屆成員

options.explanation: cohort members = 同期開始同一課程的人。2022年一起入讀正是關鍵。
project teammates = 同一專題組員。句子沒有專題背景。

words.note: pupil 多用於中小學學生，尤其常見於英式英語。fellow pupils 指其他一起上學的學生。
words.example: The boy shared his lunch with his fellow pupils.
words.exampleZh: 那個男孩和其他同學分享午餐。

exercises.original: The ten-year-old shared his lunch with his classmates at primary school.
exercises.zh: 那名十歲男孩在小學和其他同學分享午餐。
exercises.upgrade: fellow pupils · 同學；同校學生

options.explanation: fellow pupils = 其他一起上學的小學生。句子是 primary school，pupil 很自然。

exercises.original: The young girl was encouraged by her classmates during the school performance.
exercises.zh: 那名女孩在學校表演時得到其他同學鼓勵。
exercises.upgrade: fellow pupils · 同學；同校學生

options.explanation: fellow pupils = 其他在校學生，特別適合兒童及學校情境。
teachers = 老師；可能鼓勵她，但不是「同學」。

words.meaning: 一同學習的人；學習夥伴
words.note: 強調大家都是學習者，常見於成人教育、語言課程或培訓情境。
words.example: She practises conversation with fellow learners in the evening class.
words.exampleZh: 她在夜校班和其他學員練習會話。

exercises.original: She practises conversation with her classmates in an adult evening language course.
exercises.zh: 她在成人夜間語言課程中和其他學員練習會話。
exercises.upgrade: fellow learners · 一同學習的人；學習夥伴

options.explanation: fellow learners = 一起學習的人。成人教育中未必強調傳統「班級」，這個說法很自然。

exercises.original: Online students can discuss difficult exercises with classmates on the learning platform.
exercises.zh: 網上學生可以在學習平台和其他學習者討論困難的練習。
exercises.upgrade: fellow learners · 一同學習的人

options.explanation: fellow learners = 一同學習的人。網上課程未必有傳統實體班級，因此很適合。
schoolmates = 同校學生；網上學習平台未必屬於同一所學校。

words.note: 最直接、最清楚地表示真正「在同一班」的學生。
words.example: The students in the same class worked together on the science project.
words.exampleZh: 同班學生一起完成科學專題。

exercises.original: The classmates in Room 4B must submit the assignment by Friday.
exercises.zh: 4B班的同班學生必須在星期五前交功課。
exercises.upgrade: students in the same class · 同班學生

options.explanation: 這個說法直接強調大家真正屬於同一班，和 Room 4B 的班級語境吻合。

exercises.original: All the classmates who sit in this classroom have the same mathematics teacher.
exercises.zh: 在這個課室上課的同班學生都有同一位數學老師。
exercises.upgrade: students in the same class · 同班學生

options.explanation: schoolmates = 同校學生，範圍太廣。
句子強調同一課室及同一位老師，所以明確是同班學生。

words.note: 在學校或大學處於同一年級的人，不一定修讀完全相同的科目。
words.example: She knows many students in the same year from different classes.
words.exampleZh: 她認識很多不同班別但同年級的學生。

exercises.original: She knows many classmates in Year 10, even though they are in different classes.
exercises.zh: 她認識很多十年級的學生，雖然他們分屬不同班別。
exercises.upgrade: students in the same year · 同年級學生

options.explanation: 同一年級但不同班別，正好需要這個說法。
study partners = 一起溫習的人；句子沒有說他們一起溫習。

exercises.original: The school organized a sports day for classmates in the same grade from six different classes.
exercises.zh: 學校為來自六個不同班別的同年級學生舉辦運動日。
exercises.upgrade: students in the same year · 同年級學生

options.explanation: 來自不同班，但屬於同一年級，所以這個說法最準確。

words.note: 修讀同一個學位、文憑或培訓計劃的人。
words.example: Students in the same program often take several core subjects together.
words.exampleZh: 同一學程的學生通常會一起修讀幾個核心科目。

exercises.original: Her classmates are all enrolled in the same three-year design program, although they choose different electives.
exercises.zh: 她的同學都修讀同一個三年制設計學程，但選修科不同。
exercises.upgrade: students in the same program · 同學程學生

options.explanation: 大家修讀同一個設計學程，即使選修科不同，仍屬同一 program。
class = 班級或課堂，不是人。

exercises.original: Classmates in the engineering degree often take the same core subjects during the first year.
exercises.zh: 同一工程學位課程的學生在第一年通常修讀相同的核心科目。
exercises.upgrade: students in the same program · 同學程學生

options.explanation: schoolmates = 同校學生，範圍可能太廣。
句子明確指出同一 engineering degree，所以最準確。

words.note: 在實驗課中一起完成實驗的人。重點是共同做實驗，不一定只是一般同班關係。
words.example: The two lab partners checked their results before leaving the laboratory.
words.exampleZh: 兩名實驗搭檔在離開實驗室前核對了結果。

exercises.original: During chemistry class, the two classmates worked together at the same bench and completed every experiment as a pair.
exercises.zh: 在化學課上，兩名同學在同一張實驗枱工作，並以二人一組完成所有實驗。
exercises.upgrade: lab partners · 實驗搭檔

options.explanation: 兩人一起做實驗，而且固定成對合作，所以 lab partners 最精準。
schoolmates = 同校學生，沒有表達一起做實驗的關係。

exercises.original: My classmate and I checked each other's measurements before writing the laboratory report.
exercises.zh: 我和實驗搭檔在撰寫實驗報告前互相核對測量結果。
exercises.upgrade: lab partners · 實驗搭檔

options.explanation: 共同量度並撰寫實驗報告，明顯是實驗搭檔關係。
coursemates = 同課程同學；可能正確但沒有 lab partners 那麼精準地指出兩人合作做實驗。

words.note: 經常一起溫習、練習或準備考試的人。
words.example: My study partner and I review vocabulary every Friday.
words.exampleZh: 我和溫習夥伴每逢星期五一起複習詞彙。

exercises.original: My classmate and I meet every Friday to review vocabulary and test each other.
exercises.zh: 我和溫習夥伴每逢星期五見面，一起複習詞彙並互相測試。
exercises.upgrade: study partners · 溫習夥伴；學習搭檔

options.explanation: 兩人固定一起溫習及互相測試，正是 study partners。

exercises.original: The two classmates agreed to prepare for the examination together every evening.
exercises.zh: 兩名同學同意每晚一起準備考試。
exercises.upgrade: study partners · 溫習夥伴

options.explanation: project teammates = 一起做專題的人，不一定一起溫習考試。
重點是固定一起準備考試，所以最合適。

words.note: 一起完成同一個專題或項目的同學。
words.example: Her project teammates divided the research tasks among themselves.
words.exampleZh: 她的專題組員把研究工作分配好。

exercises.original: Her classmates divided the research tasks because they were working on the same group project.
exercises.zh: 她的專題組員因為一起做同一個小組專題，所以分配了研究工作。
exercises.upgrade: project teammates · 專題組員；項目隊友

options.explanation: 大家共同完成同一專題並分工，project teammates 最精準。
schoolmates = 同校學生，沒有共同做專題的意思。

exercises.original: The classmates met online to combine their slides for the final group presentation.
exercises.zh: 專題組員在網上開會，把各自的投影片合併成期末小組簡報。
exercises.upgrade: project teammates · 專題組員

options.explanation: study partners = 一起溫習的人；這裡不是準備考試，而是共同完成專題。
共同製作小組簡報，正是專題組員。

words.note: 屬於同一個學習小組、討論小組或課堂分組的人。
words.example: Each group member had to present one part of the report.
words.exampleZh: 每名小組成員都要匯報報告的一部分。

exercises.original: Each classmate in the discussion group had to present one part of the report.
exercises.zh: 討論小組中的每名成員都要匯報報告的一部分。
exercises.upgrade: group members · 小組成員

options.explanation: 句子說的是同一討論小組內的人，所以 group members 最準確。
class = 班級，不是小組中的人。

exercises.original: The classmates in our reading group take turns choosing the book for the week.
exercises.zh: 我們閱讀小組的成員輪流選擇每星期要讀的書。
exercises.upgrade: group members · 小組成員

options.explanation: 大家屬於同一閱讀小組，所以這個說法最直接。
coursemates = 同課程同學；可能是同一課程，但句子真正強調的是 reading group。

falseSynonyms.zh: 朋友不等於同學 朋友表示私人關係；同學只是一起讀書的人。兩者可以重疊，但不一定相同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A friend has a personal relationship with you. A classmate studies in the same class as you.

falseSynonyms.zh: 同事不等於同學 colleague 通常指一起工作的人，不是一起上課的學生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A colleague works with you. A classmate studies with you.

falseSynonyms.zh: 隊友不一定是同班同學 teammate 強調同一隊伍。運動隊友或項目隊友可能不是同一班。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A teammate belongs to the same team. A classmate belongs to the same class.

falseSynonyms.zh: 室友不等於同學 roommate 是一起住的人。室友可能在不同學校或不同課程。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A roommate shares a room or home with you. A classmate shares a class with you.

falseSynonyms.zh: 鄰居不等於同學 neighbour 指住在附近的人，和是否一起上課沒有直接關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A neighbour lives near you. A classmate studies in the same class as you.

falseSynonyms.zh: 老師不等於同學 老師負責教學，學生負責學習。兩者在課堂中的角色不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A teacher teaches the class. Classmates are students in the class.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學生範圍更廣 students 可以指任何學生；classmates 特別指和某人在同一班的學生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON All classmates are students, but not all students are classmates.

falseSynonyms.zh: 字形相近，意思不同 class 是班級或課堂；classmate 是同班學生。先檢查句子需要「人」還是「班／課」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Our class starts at nine. One of my classmates sits beside me.
